description: Library x compiler matrix registry: which libraries exist, which languages build ports, and which ports exist. See README.md for every field.

rust.label: Rust (mires)
rust.production: mires js-profile=release-size js-opt=on js-ecma-target=2018 js-cleanup=off, unwind mode, JSC_RUST_OPT_LEVEL=z, js-lane=jir; minimal shim, Rollup, Terser ecma 2018

rescript.label: ReScript
rescript.production: ReScript 12.3.0 esmodule; Rollup + node-resolve (@rescript/runtime); common Terser

melange.label: Melange
melange.production: Melange 7.0.1 melange.emit es6, emit_stdlib; Rollup + node-resolve; common Terser

jsoo.label: js_of_ocaml
jsoo.production: js_of_ocaml 6.4.1 whole_program --opt=3 --effects=disabled --target-env=browser --no-extern-fs; module facade; common Terser

scalajs.label: Scala.js
scalajs.production: Scala 3.8.4 / Scala.js 1.22.0 fullLinkJS (scala-cli --js-mode release, ES modules); common Terser

dart.label: Dart (dart2js)
dart.production: dart compile js -O2 --no-source-maps; comparator facade; common Terser

kotlin.label: Kotlin/JS
kotlin.production: Gradle 9.4.1 / Kotlin plugin 2.4.10 compileProductionExecutableKotlinJs, whole-program ES module, ES2015; Terser 2 passes

elm.label: Elm (+ JS host)
elm.production: elm make --optimize; comparator wrapper; compiler-aware Terser on the Elm module; Rollup over the JS host; common Terser

gopherjs.label: Go (GopherJS)
gopherjs.production: GopherJS 1.21.0 + Go 1.21.13 gopherjs build -m; comparator facade; common Terser

package.name: pilot-wordfreq
package.standIn: a handwritten module in this harness that stands in for an npm package

package.name: matrix-floor
package.standIn: the identity program; its ports measure each language's runtime floor uniformly
